people.name: Daniel
people.line: Prophet in Babylon, known for wisdom and visions

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: in the first year of his reign I, Daniel, understood by the books the number of the years about which Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah the prophet, for the accomplishing of the desolations of Jerusalem, even seventy years.
translations.bsb: in the first year of his reign, I, Daniel, understood from the sacred books, according to the word of the LORD to Jeremiah the prophet, that the desolation of Jerusalem would last seventy years.
translations.kjv: In the first year of his reign I Daniel understood by books the number of the years, whereof the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah the prophet, that he would accomplish seventy years in the desolations of Jerusalem.
translations.asv: in the first year of his reign I, Daniel, understood by the books the number of the years whereof the word of Jehovah came to Jeremiah the prophet, for the accomplishing of the desolations of Jerusalem, even seventy years.
